user.description: Enter the address of the Ubuntu host. A dedicated Ed25519 key pair will be created.

install.title: Install monitoring account
install.description:
Run this command on the Ubuntu host as a privileged administrator (review the installer source first):

{command}

Then find the server's SSH host-key fingerprint using: sudo ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub -E sha256

Enter the complete SHA256:... fingerprint below and submit to verify the connection.
